title: Synthesis, Characterization, HSA/DNA Binding, and Cytotoxic Activity of [RuCl(2)(eta(6)-p-cymene)(bph-kappaN)] Complex.
authors: Perendija, Stefan; Dimic, Dusan; Eichhorn, Thomas; Rakic, Aleksandra; Saso, Luciano; Nakarada, Dura; Dikic, Dragoslava; Dragojevic, Teodora; Dimitric Markovic, Jasmina; Kaluderovic, Goran N
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钌配合物与DNA的嵌合结合及抗癌活性，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法以DFT和对接为主，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: A novel ruthenium(II) complex, [RuCl(2)(eta(6)-p-cymene)(bph-kappaN)] (1), was synthesized and structurally characterized using FTIR and NMR spectroscopy. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations supported the proposed geometry and allowed for comparative analysis of experimental and theoretical spectroscopic data. The interaction of complex 1 with human serum albumin (HSA) and calf thymus DNA was investigated through fluorescence quenching experiments, revealing spontaneous binding driven primarily by hydrophobic interactions. The thermodynamic parameters indicated mixed quenching mechanisms in both protein and DNA systems. Ethidium bromide displacement assays and molecular docking simulations confirmed DNA intercalation as the dominant binding mode, with a Gibbs free binding energy of -34.1 kJ mol(-1). Antioxidant activity, assessed by EPR spectroscopy, demonstrated effective scavenging of hydroxyl and ascorbyl radicals. In vitro cytotoxicity assays against A375, MDA-MB-231, MIA PaCa-2, and SW480 cancer cell lines revealed selective activity, with pancreatic and colorectal cells showing the highest sensitivity. QTAIM analysis provided insight into metal-ligand bonding characteristics and intramolecular stabilization. These findings highlight the potential of 1 as a promising candidate for further development as an anticancer agent, particularly against multidrug-resistant tumors.
abstract_zh: 一种新型钌(II)配合物[RuCl(2)(eta(6)-对伞花烃)(bph-κN)] (1)被合成，并通过FTIR和NMR光谱进行了结构表征。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算支持了所提出的几何结构，并允许对实验和理论光谱数据进行对比分析。通过荧光猝灭实验研究了配合物1与人血清白蛋白 (HSA) 和小牛胸腺DNA的相互作用，揭示了主要由疏水相互作用驱动的自发结合。热力学参数表明，在蛋白质和DNA系统中均存在混合猝灭机制。溴化乙锭置换实验和分子对接模拟确认了DNA嵌入是主要结合模式，吉布斯自由结合能为-34.1 kJ mol(-1)。通过EPR光谱评估的抗氧化活性显示，其能有效清除羟基和抗坏血酸自由基。针对A375、MDA-MB-231、MIA PaCa-2和SW480癌细胞系的体外细胞毒性实验揭示了选择性活性，其中胰腺和结直肠细胞表现出最高的敏感性。QTAIM分析提供了对金属-配体键合特性和分子内稳定性的见解。这些发现突显了1作为抗癌剂进一步开发的潜在候选物，特别是针对多药耐药肿瘤。
